hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Manages Uniswap v4 pools for Clanker-deployed tokens with asymmetric static fees (separate clankerFee and pairedFee per direction), collecting a protocol cut via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta on each swap. Supports an optional time-limited MEV protection module that can temporarily raise fees, and LP locker fee auto-claiming.
